about: Rink positions of the 56 keypoints the SimulaMet HockeyRink model predicts, in the coach-review frame: metres, x along the rink with the center line at 0, y across it with the far boards at +15 and the camera-side boards at -15. The model publishes no keypoint names; these were read off its training annotations (frames 4018a512, 461afa40 and 05b1b4f2 of the HockeyRink dataset) and assume an IIHF 60 x 30 rink. Trapezoid widths follow the NHL trapezoid (6.7 m at the goal line, 8.5 m at the end boards). Hash marks are placed 0.9 m either side of their faceoff dot.
